title: Breadcrumbs
draft: Claude's draft 2026-10-17 from story_script_v1 §5 (2.7), outbreak_origin_v1 §3 (incubation & misdiagnosis: 'acute viral encephalitis', the cover-up works for months), §5 (delivered only through the News app, Reels and chatter — no exposition), §6 (the player's IT firm builds HIVR's sample-tracking software: 'Batch AMR-07: status overwritten'), game_components §3 (News: weekly headline escalation; Reels mirror it). The user edits the words and the numbers; then P16 builds it.
time: Four working days after 2.6 — each night in the flat moves the story one 'week' on (the headlines are dated a week apart); the last evening closes Act 2
player_goal: Live the routine while the News app escalates.
design_goal: Quiet dread (the Feed / World War Z method): nothing happens to you, everything happens around you. Each morning the News app has one more headline, a Reel echoes it, and something small at the office is off — Sameer's cough, his empty desk, a data glitch the client wants buried, the night guard saluting nobody. Reveal: the News app. Progress: Act 2 closes; Act 3 opens on the Outer Ring Road.

cast.role: Day 1 at the gate in the evening, coughing ('PG food. It's always the PG food.'). Days 2–3 absent — his chat: 'fever 102. doctor says viral. dont tell divya i'm watching reels.' Day 4 back, pale, a mask in his pocket he doesn't wear: 'Tested for everything. Negative for everything. They said viral.'

Day 3, evening: standing at attention, saluting the empty gate. A full minute. He doesn't answer. Then he blinks, lowers his hand, and asks if you've had dinner. (The Severance beat — no explanation, ever.)
Phone, day 2: 'Can you check why Batch AMR-07 shows status overwritten in the HIVR tracker? Client's asking. Don't escalate yet.' — the first clue (clue_amr07) of the employer's paper trail.

beats.what: Morning 1: a new app on the phone — News. First headline: 'Mystery fever: 11 admitted at Hebbal General; doctors say viral, no cause for alarm.' A Reel (@north_blr_updates): a hospital queue at night, sped up. Workday at the office; in the evening Sameer at the gate, coughing.

Morning 2: 'HIVR calls leak rumours baseless; Project Amrita purely agricultural, says director Dr. Meera Krishnamurthy.' Sameer's desk is empty (his chat: fever 102). Divya's message after the workday: Batch AMR-07, status overwritten — 'don't escalate yet.'

Morning 3: 'Ward sealed at Hebbal General; families wait outside overnight.' A Reel: a taped door, a nurse shaking her head at the camera. Evening at the gate: the guard saluting nobody, a full minute.
Morning 4: 'Yelahanka schools shut as a precaution after staff fall ill.' Sameer is back, pale. On the bus home, two aunties argue about whether to stock rice. Reel: a supermarket aisle with no rice.

Evening 4, the flat: Amma calls. 'Come home for a few weeks? Your father won't say it, so I'm saying it.' — 'Work won't let me, Amma.' / 'Maybe next month.' Either way she says 'Eat properly' and hangs up. You sleep; Act 2 ends (act2_done). (Act 3 opens on the Outer Ring Road at night.)

economy.trigger: bus / auto to the office and back, four days (existing fares)

exits.note: no new places: the flat, the hill, the office gate

assets_needed: no new art: the flat, the hill, the office gate
the News app screen on the phone kit (a list of dated headlines, newest first, tap for two lines) — like Notes
four new Reels (text cards, as the existing ones)
sleepEvents gains 'the n-th night after X' (nights) so one flag can schedule four mornings
acceptance: the first night after act2_app_done unlocks News with headline 1; each later night in the flat adds one headline (four in all) and a matching Reel
Sameer: coughing at the gate (day 1), absent with a chat (days 2–3), back pale (day 4)
Divya's AMR-07 message after the day-2 workday sets clue_amr07
day 3 evening: the guard's salute at the gate (once)
day 4 evening at the flat: Amma's call; both answers set act2_done
the walkthrough bot plays the four days and the headless run stays green (17 of 17)
open_questions: HOW MANY DAYS: draft = four working days, each night = one 'week' in the headlines (compressed). Or play four real weeks with a 'week passes' card between them (like the workday card)?
The HEADLINES' words (draft above) — and should the HIVR director be named in a headline already (Dr. Meera Krishnamurthy), or only in Act 3?
SAMEER: draft = sick and back, negative for everything ('viral'). Or does he stay off and not come back (darker)?
The GUARD: draft = a full-minute salute, then normal, never explained. Keep? (It's an early symptom only the player notices.)
AMR-07: draft = Divya's chat sets a clue flag and nothing else yet (the investigate thread is Act 3). Or a small task now (open the tracker at the office)?
DEEPA, the hill neighbour who works night shifts at HIVR (outbreak bible §6): introduce her now (comes home at dawn, scared, says nothing) or wait for Act 3? Draft: wait.
ACT 2's ENDING: draft = Amma's call, then sleep → act2_done. Or end on the guard / on a Reel?
The NEWS APP: draft = a list like Notes (tap a headline for two lines). Or headlines only?
